title: Product Owner Lending Platform (f/m/d)
description:
We are looking for a Product Owner for our consumer lending platform.

What you'll do
- Own the backlog for application, scoring integration and servicing flows
- Work with risk, legal and engineering on release scope
- Define success metrics and review them with leadership

What you bring
- 5+ years as Product Owner, or 3 years with a relevant master's degree
- Experience in lending, banking or payments products
- Strong stakeholder management and written English
